source_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one four-view orthographic turnaround sheet for reconstruction with local Hunyuan3D multi-view. Create a wide 2048x1024 image with exactly FOUR isolated views of the SAME complete prop, left to right FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT, with NO written labels. Pure white background, no ground and no cast shadow. Four evenly spaced columns; each whole object including protrusions must fit inside its own column with white margins, never overlap neighboring views. Align baselines and use exactly the same physical scale and height in all views. True orthographic views, no perspective and no three-quarter view.
Style: readable moderate-detail hand-painted fantasy FPS environment at Gunfire Reborn game fidelity. Bold chunky solid silhouette, clean gently chamfered faceted planes, two or three large coherent matte color blocks, soft painted gradients and a few restrained edge-wear accents. Neutral even lighting; no photorealism, dense wood grain, tiny cracks or elaborate miniature carving. No text, icon labels, loose floating parts or thin strings. All parts form one coherent assembled prop. Subject: one short abandoned wooden cargo skiff sitting flat on its intact heavy keel, approximately 2.3 metres across, 4.8 metres long and 1.7 metres from keel to highest gunwale. Front faces the broad blunt bow, back faces the square low stern, left and right show the full hull length. Thick broad blue-grey weathered timber hull planks, a massive rounded gunwale, and two thick connected cross seats visible slightly above the rim. No mast, sail, rigging, rudder pole or oars. The boat is fully volumetric with a deep belly and substantial underside, not a flat cutout. A small broad chipped section in the stern gunwale and two missing upper board corners suggest abandonment, while the entire lower hull and keel remain intact and connected. A few broad pale blue-grey snow patches (clearly darker than the pure-white backdrop) are firmly attached to the bow rim and benches, less than fifteen percent surface coverage; avoid icicles or snow spray. Restrained cold blue-grey wood, warm exposed board edges, dark iron end straps. One complete boat, no lake, shore, rocks or separate debris.
source_history.role: edit target / original complete four-view design
source_history.reason: Preserve bright snow with native alpha instead of white key.
